scope: Current Windows protection audit tooling only, separate from frozen release artifacts and native code.
finding: Root and descendant user rules required read/execute presence and excluded named low write bits, but did not exclude additional generic or unknown bits. The actual extracted old root predicate admits read/execute combined with generic all, write, execute or an unknown bit in memory-only rule models.
correction: One shared pure predicate accepts exactly read/execute or read/execute plus synchronize. Both existing root and descendant paths use it. Identity, Allow type, inheritance, propagation, four-rule/OWNER RIGHTS policy, schema2 fields, Apply ordering, recovery and CLI remain unchanged.

evidence.before: Three focused checks fail before correction. The real extracted root predicate accepts both valid models but rejects only five of nine weakened models, not the expected nine. This demonstrates a predicate gap, not a filesystem exploit.
evidence.after: All13 focused and107 final data-only package/epoch/protection cases pass with no skips. The final in-memory root matrix accepts two valid values and rejects ten invalid values, including signed generic read. All seven verifier tests, supported-target policy, typecheck and whitespace checks pass. No whole protection script or native candidate executes locally.
evidence.independentReview: Exact corrected source review accepts the scalar Boolean predicate and both pipeline integrations; Apply/recovery/CLI and the preceding source prefix match their prior bytes. A suggested signed generic-read regression is added; final test-only delta and scoped public documentation reviews accept the change. No reviewer runtime action or write.
evidence.sourceCi: Not committed or pushed at initial source-review capture; fresh exact-source CI including package smoke remains required. Local native smoke is not invoked through its known policy-override route.

limits: Source and memory-only evidence, not an observed NTFS bypass, actual protection Apply, owned recovery fixture, current candidate boundary, game/device QA or release qualification. No permission, security policy, frozen artifact, helper/native payload, tag, registry publication or deployment changed. Existing native prototype and unrelated research changes remain outside this source slice.
